description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadirawalana, Ihalagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420350 (23/0404)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed information about land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and legal encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural changes, nor does it fit any other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
